releases.body:
Fold-diffs fixes:
- options bridge so opencode.json options reach the TUI (cli.json still wins)
- support the public 2.2.3 event set; remove the unsupported content event
- find scrolled-up transcripts and avoid latching onto the first sticky scrollbox
- preserve per-part fold state across remounts and refresh stale stats
- clear click handlers and restore host maxHeight/gap/padding on cleanup
- bash: avoid folding output that starts with `$`, measure wrapped rows, restore the two-row clamp
- accept finite options only; tighten code detection and diff header counting

57 tests passing.
Published to npm by GitHub Actions via npm Trusted Publishing. No functional changes since 0.3.5; this release adds the CI publish workflow.
